items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves

Check any leakage from pump & piping flanges and re-tighten ( if 
 it is needed )
Check glands for leaking then re-tighten it (if it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed). .

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).

Clean external part with 
 compressed air

text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which 
 must be carried out on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block.
This pump is used for transfer 
 condensate water from hot well condenser to storage tank
Technical Specifications:
Quantity | 4
Type | Vertical Centrifugal Pump- CEXD 300.3
Number 
 of Stages | 3
Speed | 1485 rpm
Flow | 702 m3/h
Pressure | 17 bar
Original 
 Lubricant | ISO VG 46
Total Quantity 
 of Lubricant | 3 L
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy, tested by 
 eng. Ahmad Shanab, accepted by general 
 manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib, approved by 
 eng. Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria 
 power station and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana.
This document
 certified by eng. Samir Abd Elgelil inspection & quality control 
 general manager & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagib inspection and quality control head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings.
Check discharge quantity and pressure.
Check any leakage from pump & piping flanges and re-tighten ( if 
 it is needed )
Measure bearing temperature
Check glands for leaking then re-tighten it (if it is needed).
Pump out of 
Operation
Check the validity of oil and add 
 or change it (if it is needed). .
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Clean external part with 
 compressed air
